reference.authors: Mukund Sundararajan, Ankur Taly, Qiqi Yan
reference.title: Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks

selection_rationale: Established gradient attribution method requiring no classifier retraining or architectural modification.
Class-specific and directly applicable to the frozen EVA-X-S image classifier.
Produces an input-space spatial attribution map without relying on undocumented attention-weight exposure.
Avoids adapting a model-specific Transformer relevance-propagation implementation to EVA-X-S after observing locked-test localization results.

alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: Established Transformer-specific attention-flow method but standard rollout is not inherently class-specific and depends on accessible attention matrices.

Strong Transformer-specific method but requires model-specific relevance propagation through attention/residual components; higher risk of changing/instrumenting the frozen EVA implementation beyond the minimum needed for a sensitivity comparator.

population: all 1,203 canonical RSNA GT-positive locked-test cases when computationally feasible

integrated_gradients.baseline: zero tensor in normalized EVA input space

multiplicity: Holm correction across four primary EVA method-sensitivity p-values
